dogecoin.text: JUST IN: Dogecoin price surges to $0.34, solidifying its position as the 7th largest cryptocurrency by market cap. Strong momentum maintained with $50B+ cap and $3.2B daily trading volume. Institutional interest and whale activity driving bullish trend. #Dogecoin

JUST IN: Dogecoin surges 13% in 15 minutes as US Government Efficiency Department launches official .gov website with Dogecoin logo and Elon Musk affiliation. Price boost breaks short-term downtrend. #Dogecoin #DOGE #ElonMusk

JUST IN: Nasdaq seeks SEC approval to trade Dogecoin via an ETF. This move follows a surge of similar applications for crypto ETFs, including altcoins like Solana and Sui. If approved, Dogecoin could soon be part of mainstream investment portfolios.
